agent q <provider> <query-name>.policyBasis: the provider is the closed set [a-z0-9-]+ and every later operand a plain token (cmddesc allowedLiteralSets pg-review-provider and pg-review-agent-arg); the node's only effect is its stdout EffectStdio, judged by effectpolicy.StdioIsLocal (always Permitted)

agent q <provider> <query-name> <arg wit.policyBasis: an operand outside the closed literal set makes the interpretation insufficient, so no EffectPolicy judges it (fail-closed abstain)

--run.policyBasis: no effect is produced by a literal flag; the node only has its stdout EffectStdio, judged by effectpolicy.StdioIsLocal (always Permitted)

--output.policyBasis: no effect is produced by a literal flag; the node only has its stdout EffectStdio, judged by effectpolicy.StdioIsLocal (always Permitted)

agent file <findings>.policyBasis: an unmodeled positional makes the interpretation insufficient; agent file files into the ledger and the unattended analyst does not use it (fail-closed abstain)

agent context, human *, job *.policyBasis: no spec entry: an unmodeled subcommand is insufficient (fail-closed abstain)

positionals.policyBasis: see the flags table: the verdict follows the subcommand and the operand shape
